retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 1970s-style album cover featuring a full-bleed sunset seascape with a centered inset portrait and bold, shadowed slab-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition where a warm, golden-hour ocean sunset serves as the base. A rectangular portrait of a male subject is inset in the lower-left quadrant, framed by a thin yellow border. The top third is dominated by large, blue, shadowed slab-serif text, while secondary information is placed in a black pill-shaped banner and a yellow rectangular badge.
coreVisualRelationships: Inset portrait framed against a full-bleed seascape
Large blue display text anchored at the top center
Black horizontal banner separating primary and secondary titles
Yellow accent badge providing high-contrast metadata placement
Warm sunset tones contrasting with cool blue typography
coreInvariants: Inset rectangular portrait with a thin yellow border
Heavy slab-serif font for the primary subject name
Blue text with a black drop shadow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary human subject is in a medium-shot inset box, occupying the bottom-left and center-bottom area. The background seascape fills the entire frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue slab-serif name at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large blue text, move down to the black banner, then to the inset portrait, and finally to the metadata on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the image over the ocean waves provides breathing room for secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm oranges and browns from the sunset seascape.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright cyan-blue used for the primary name to pop against the warm background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow used for borders and the metadata badge.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sunset and blue text; the inset portrait has a more natural, slightly muted color palette.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and elegant script
letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses ultra-bold slab serifs with thick strokes
Secondary titles use a fluid, slanted formal script
Metadata uses a clean, italicized serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Blue letters feature a hard black drop shadow for depth
Script text features high stroke contrast and looping ascenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, masculine slab-serif with a delicate, feminine script.
graphicDevices: Thin yellow frame for inset photo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure of the main name.
Provides the necessary calligraphic contrast for the top line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style photograph of a sunset over a calm ocean with golden and brown tones. Inset a rectangular portrait of a smiling man in a vintage patterned shirt in the lower-left, framed with a thin yellow line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large cyan-blue slab-serif text with black shadows at the top. Place a black pill-shaped banner below it with white script text. Add a yellow badge and white italicized serif text on the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the background a full-bleed sunset seascape?
Is the main name in blue slab-serif with a shadow?
Is there a yellow-bordered inset portrait?
Is the script text placed above the main name?

mustRedesign: Do not use modern digital gradients; keep the photographic grain.

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between name and metadata

postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue text is legible against the sunset.
Ensure the inset photo border is thin and consistent.
Verify the script text is elegant and not blocky.
Confirm the black banner is centered under the main name.
Check for the presence of the yellow metadata badge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Sunset Seascape + Inset Portrait + Heavy Slab Serif (Blue/Shadow) + Script Accent + Yellow Badge
